items.title: A check, not a show
items.body:
This is the week boss. You already met these pointers. You are only proving you can name them.

1. **Product name** :  change it in the booklet; two pages follow.
2. **Warning pointer** :  change the library; two how-tos follow.
3. **A sentence you copied** :  because a pointer would have been the wrong tool.

Fail the quiz and **week 5 stays locked**. Retry as many times as you want. The 5-minute warmup does not open the week.

items.title: Word today
items.body: No new word. Use **key**, **conref**, **conkeyref**, and **local note** in the three sentences you write.

lessons.title: Three proofs on a check copy

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: A warning sentence exists twice, or the product name only works on one page, or you cannot explain a pointer, or completeness is red.

Expected: Check copy clean. Two pages use the product name. At least one shared warning pointer. Three explanation sentences.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Copy kitepump to oxygen-bootcamp-work/week4-check/ so you do not wreck the original.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Prove the product name: change it in the booklet; two pages follow.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Prove one reused warning: change the library sentence; two how-tos follow.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Break 1: unset the root map. Write what the names looked like. Restore.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Break 2: typo the warning pointer. Write what you saw. Repair.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Break 3: put a path pointer back next to the name pointer on the same note. Delete the path form.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.body: Write three sentences: what the product name owns, what the warning pointer owns, which sentence you copied on purpose.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.body: Completeness clean on the check copy.

steps.title: Step 9
steps.body: Pass the quiz. Week 5 stays locked until this day is finished (lab + quiz + a short note).

blocks.summary: Check copy clean. Two pages use the product name. At least one shared warning pointer. Three explanation sentences.

blocks.q: A product name looks broken in Author. First place you look?
options: The root map and the name in the booklet
blocks.why: Names live in the booklet. Root map plus the name line. Not a version number.

blocks.q: You failed this check. Does week 5 open?
options: No. Week 5 stays locked until this day is finished. Retry the quiz if you need to.
Yes, if the 5-minute warmup is done
blocks.why: Lab, quiz, and a short note. Retry is free. The warmup does not open the week.

blocks.q: A path pointer and a name pointer both sit on the same warning. What do you do?
options: Keep both, in case one breaks
Keep the name pointer and delete the path
Delete both and type the sentence twice
blocks.why: Two pointers will drift. The better form is the name in the booklet.
